title: Follow Up Transcript Assays: RT Primer Pools, Differential Junctions and Specificity

catalog.notes: Offline synthetic PATZ1 follow-up after qPCR exon junctions and transcript panels: terminal-exon RT primer pool geometry, differential junction selection and missing threshold provenance, transcript-assay specificity planning/finalization, and gene-isoform study orchestration with two separate approval stages.
